root_cause: Original assessPreventivePublicationReadiness uses the same isTerminal callback for provider-side-effect idempotency and independently verified live proof. An original LinkedIn personal PUBLISHED state with provider ACK and real ID, provider_truth_verified=false, live_proven_at=NULL and independent GET Forbidden was therefore incorrectly placed in ready with proof ORIGINAL_TERMINAL_PROVIDER_READBACK. The original obligations projection also omitted approved_at and live_proven_at fields required by the classifier.
fix: Same-original-loop read-only preflight classifies provider ACK without independent readback as INDEPENDENT_PROVIDER_READBACK_REQUIRED/ORIGINAL_PROVIDER_RECONCILE_ONLY and reads original approved_at/live_proven_at. No second provider transport, no forged proof, no new scheduler, no approval bypass.
prevention_rule: Separately assert idempotent provider ACK and independently verified LIVE_PROVEN; never emit ORIGINAL_TERMINAL_PROVIDER_READBACK for provider_truth_verified=false. Include real approval/proof columns in the original read model and test positive verified and negative ACK-only cases before release.
